supersedes.reason: In 0.1.4 (and 0.1.5) mgcv::s() inside mgcv::gam() formulas raised 'invalid type (list)', so every spline fit silently fell back to LOESS (conservative smoother) or lm (standard smoother). 0.1.6 uses s() so the documented P-spline and cubic-spline GAM smoothers are used.
